children: iShares European Property Yield UCITS ETF (the "Fund") - ISIN: IE00B0M63284 and IE00BGDQ0L74
The directors of the Company wish to advise of changes being made to the FTSE EPRA/Nareit Developed Europe ex UK Dividend+ Index (the "Index"), the benchmark index of the Fund, as detailed below.

Currently, companies with a forecasted dividend yield of equal to or greater than 2% are eligible for inclusion. Following the changes, new constituents will be eligible for inclusion if their forecasted dividend yield is equal to or greater than 3%, while existing constituents will only be removed if their forecasted dividend yield falls below 1%.
The changes to the Index are due to take effect on or around 21 September 2026 (the "Effective Date").
A new version of the Company's prospectus will be published on or around the Effective Date.

An electronic copy of the full shareholder letter shall be made available shortly for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism and available to download from the iShares website www.ishares.com
